scope: Completion of Steffel 1791/1809 as a fully computational, AI-assisted historical-digital scholarly edition and reusable RHD reference implementation, with zero required human adjudication.
interpretation: Weighted completion of the machine-only scholarly edition. It is not a human-validation rate and does not imply a human-reviewed critical edition.

dimensions.label: Documentary coverage, segmentation and diplomatic transcription
dimensions.completion_gate: All candidate boundaries disposed and all active dictionary articles represented in the AI-assisted documentary layer.

dimensions.label: Machine recollation, uncertainty accounting and non-destructive critical status
dimensions.note: All 482 open cases have a machine epistemic disposition: 284 confirmed_ai_assisted, 152 corrected_ai_assisted and 46 unresolved_after_ai_recollation. Unresolved is an allowed terminal scholarly state in the machine-only edition.
dimensions.completion_gate: Every detected issue has a traceable machine disposition, including explicit unresolved status where evidence does not justify one reading.

dimensions.label: Reusable RHD 1.0 architecture and provenance
dimensions.completion_gate: Canonical model, source profiles, provenance and invariant tests are implemented without destructive migration.

dimensions.label: TEI/TEI Lex-0/IIIF interoperability
dimensions.note: The strict Lex-0 projection validates against the official TEI Lex-0 0.9.5 RNG. The exact canonical Steffel PDF was independently re-verified as 84 pages, 6,251,443 bytes and SHA-256 4ccc94aaff1fcc948341a103255f2c3f52dd7b8ca488b6dc79a921b3c9d6244f. From that exact binary RHD now has a reproducible static-image build recipe, a versioned 84-page Canvas dimension inventory, a deterministic IIIF Presentation 3 preparation with 84 Canvases, and page-level Canvas linkage for all 1,965 active records. CI validates 0 fabricated xywh regions and keeps the public-publication gate explicitly open. Remaining work is stable public hosting/probing of the exact-binary-derived page images and final persistent public IIIF identifiers.
dimensions.completion_gate: Lex-0 validation remains green and the checksum-fixed canonical facsimile is linked through stable, publicly recoverable IIIF-compatible identifiers/images.

dimensions.label: Computational diachronic and comparative research
dimensions.note: All 298 candidate relations have reproducible documentary-retrieval support scores and are calibrated against 5,066 deterministic broken-pair null controls. A publishable machine-only report and table are generated and validated. Every relation remains candidate; semantic identity, cognacy, etymology, sound law and historical continuity remain explicit non-claims unless separately demonstrated by evidence outside this machine-only retrieval layer.
dimensions.completion_gate: Closed for the declared machine-only scope: computational candidate evidence is reproducible, null-calibrated and publishable with explicit non-claims.

dimensions.label: Numeration appendix, trilingual language sample and Lord's Prayer
dimensions.note: AI visual collation fixes PDF 79–84 to printed pp. 369–374. The numeration section is machine-structured; all 22 formulas have Latin/German/Tarahumara machine alignment with field confidence and explicit uncertainty; the separate Lord's Prayer has an AI visual transcription; all 24 appendix objects are canonicalized and serialized in a dedicated TEI supplement. All residual medium/low readings are now explicitly terminalized as machine uncertainty with no speculative repair and no human-review requirement.
dimensions.completion_gate: Closed for machine-only scope: appendices are structurally encoded, aligned, serialized and all non-secure readings remain explicit terminal uncertainty.

dimensions.label: Scientific release, archive and citability
dimensions.note: The 0.9.0 machine-only prerelease package is citation-ready in the repository, with CHANGELOG, explicit conformity/policy, and a deterministic integrity manifest that passed full CI together with the lexical, appendix, diachronic and complete Tellechea outputs. Remaining work is the final stable release plus persistent external archive/identifier; those are publication actions rather than unresolved corpus science.
dimensions.completion_gate: Stable RHD release, integrity manifest, persistent archive/identifier and explicit machine-only conformity statement are published.

dimensions.label: End-to-end replication on a second historical source
dimensions.note: Miguel Joaquín Tellechea's 1826 Compendio gramatical is the deliberately different second-source industrialization pilot. Its public DGB PDF is checksum-fixed as RHD-WIT-TELLECHEA-1826-DGB (205 pages; 95,088,307 bytes; SHA-256 c67b7942090613c494d8057be8aff59ea13a11519c29eae469afad8a85c30dfc). The complete 205-page witness traverses the declared RHD documentary pipeline in GitHub Actions. All 205 pages receive deterministic canonical documentary units; the output validates against the same RHD JSON Schema; a complete documentary TEI is generated; sparse pages use separate visual OCR fallback; the full artifact is uploaded reproducibly; no Lex-0 entries are fabricated; no universal-core redesign is required; and no human validation is claimed.
dimensions.completion_gate: Closed: the complete declared Tellechea pilot witness traverses the RHD documentary pipeline with zero fundamental redesign of the universal core.
